metadata.description: Decision memory for human- and agent-authored plans.

plugins.name: adrkit
plugins.description: Load the architecture decisions that govern a change, check work against them, and audit code, documentation, and history for decisions that were never recorded. Ships decision-memory and decision-backfill skills, a read-only decision-checker agent, and five slash commands, all driven by the adr CLI. Ships no MCP server: adrkit's MCP server is configured per project, and the skills use its tools when they are connected.
